annotations.title: Get short course and current schedules

description: Get a published short course by exact seoId with public provider/campus details. Refreshes class dates and fees on every call; if refresh fails, returns course information with schedules explicitly unavailable, never stale booking details. Read-only: use returned website links to apply.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.
